name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
title: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd - 544667 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 5.16 cr (+122.5% YoY) on 93.8% income growth, but FY26 gains come from new states and e-commerce; management guides FY27 Rs 150 cr with capacity headroom and no dividend.

utilisation.quote: capacity utilization improving to nearly 75% during the year compared to nearly 40% earlier

capex.quote: we don't have any CAPEX investment, except for the notebook machine, which we already purchased this year only

triggers.label: Utilisation ~40% → ~75%
triggers.quote: capacity utilization improving to nearly 75% during the year compared to nearly 40% earlier

triggers.label: Inventory Rs 50-54 cr at March
triggers.quote: why is the inventory so high in FY '26 last quarter, like INR 50 crores or INR 54 crores?

triggers.label: Pelican e-commerce Rs 20 cr from 50 schools
triggers.quote: out of the turnover, INR 20 crores is what we could generate from the 50 schools

guidance.quote: we are estimating more than INR 160 crores to INR 165 crores. But you know, the fair bet is 150 is definitely we will achieve

It will be around 200 to 250 somewhere in between like INR 220-230 crores definitely we will be achieving
